title: Why Templates Kill Your Brand Story

slides.text: Is your brand hiding behind a template?
slides.visual_direction: Dark near-black background, subtle amber light streak from bottom-left, minimal composition

slides.text: Templates promise ease, but sacrifice authenticity. Your brand's story deserves to be uniquely crafted.
slides.visual_direction: Dark background with faint amber circle outline top-right, clean negative space

slides.text: When you use a template, you're not building your brand's identity – you're conforming to someone else's vision.
slides.visual_direction: Near-black background with subtle amber dot grid pattern, minimal geometric, premium brand aesthetic

slides.text: Your brand's story is what sets you apart. Don't let a template dilute its impact.
slides.visual_direction: Dark background with warm amber center glow, cinematic editorial, no text in background

slides.text: By embracing your brand's uniqueness, you create a visual language that truly represents your values and mission.
slides.visual_direction: Dark near-black background, subtle amber accent line bottom-left, one focal point

slides.text: Ready to craft a brand story that's truly yours? Let's get started.
slides.visual_direction: Dark near-black background, subtle amber light streak from bottom-left, minimal composition, no text in background

caption: Break free from templates and craft a brand story that's uniquely yours. Let's get started.
